name: Do You Believe?
source:
A game where you must keep a monster locked up. Do you obey and keep it contained, or let your curiosity break through? Every choice affects your relationship with the monster.

[From [url=https://plural-goat6.itch.io/do-you-believe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款你必须把怪物关起来的游戏。你是服从并控制它，还是让你的好奇心爆发？每个选择都会影响你与怪物的关系。

[来自[url=https://plural-goat6.itch.io/do-you-believe]Itch.io[/url]]
